""" # Use itertools.combinations to get all pairs of adjacent elements pairs = list(itertools.combinations(tuples, 2)) # Filter out non-adjacent pairs pairs = [p for p in pairs if len(set(p)) == 2] # Create a new list of tuples containing the first and second elements of each pair result = [] for i, pair in enumerate(pairs): result.append((tuples[i][0], tuples[i][1])) return result ``` Tags: c#, asp.net, asp.net-mvc, razor Question: Passing a model to a view in ASP.NET MVC I am trying to pass a model to a view in ASP.NET MVC, but I am getting an error.
